set CreateRollback = 1 set tTime = $Replace($ZDATETIME($H, 3), " ", "_") SET RollbackFilename = ..DeployLogDirectory_"Deployment_" _ compNm _ "_" _ type _ "_ROLLBACK_"_tTime Do ##class(%File).Delete(RollbackFilename)
SET WhereToLog = "L" SET LogFile = ..DeployLogDirectory_"Deployment_" _ compNm _ "_" _ type _ "_LOG_"_tTime Do ##class(%File).Delete(LogFile)
Set tSC = ##class(Ens.Deployment.Deploy).DeployCode(DeploymentFile,tProductionName,CreateRollback,RollbackFilename,WhereToLog,LogFile) Write !, "Deploy status: " _ $case(tSC, 1:" OK",:"Error") Write !, "For details, view " _ LogFile, ! Quit tSC

Method.name: GetClassesForComponent
Method.Implementation:
set tSC = $$$OK NEW $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON"
&sql(Select ID INTO :compId from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.Component where ComponentName = :compNm) IF (SQLCODE '= 0) { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "Could not get Component Id for " _ compNm) Quit tSC } Write !, compNm _ ": " _ compId &sql(Declare C1 Cursor for select distinct(classname) into :clsNm from ITFCOMMON_SrcCtrl.ClassItem where componentName = :compId)
Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN C1) For { &sql(FETCH C1)
QUIT:SQLCODE=100
Do clsList.Insert(clsNm) } Write !, "Number of items in list: " _ clsList.Count() &sql(CLOSE C1) Quit tSC
